name: Lixian

queries.query: Lixian Hunan China official cadastral map parcel public map service
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Lixian People's Government portal, the Hunan Tianditu public geospatial portal, and official Hunan government material describing the provincial unified real-estate registration platform. No anonymous public parcel feature service for Lixian was identified.

queries.query: 中国 湖南 澧县 不动产登记 地图 查询 官方
queries.result: First-party discovery confirmed 澧县自然资源局 as the local custodian responsible for unified natural-resource and real-estate-rights registration, cadastral survey, real-estate surveying, and geospatial data. Official pages exposed institutional and service information, but no safe anonymous parcel ID plus geometry response or public cadastral API.

officialLeads.operator: 澧县自然资源局 (Lixian Natural Resources Bureau)
officialLeads.evidence: Official county-government institutional page states that the bureau organizes unified confirmation/registration of natural resources and real estate, cadastral surveys, real-estate surveying, registration-data management, basic surveying, and geospatial public services. This is local custodian evidence, not evidence of an open parcel API.
